messages.subject: Energy & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Morgan,

Your leadership of Braddock's Energy & Utilities practice and senior search work across energy and natural resources make this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates across mining, power, renewables and wider energy infrastructure. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
